basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school student living in the Midwest, USA. I'm deeply passionate about card games, especially Duel Masters, which I play competitively online. I'm fascinated by the arcane and have a budding interest in real witchcraft, which I explore in my free time. I'm not a fan of overly rigid structures, which is why I enjoy the freedom of online communities. My usual online hours are after school, around 4 PM to 10 PM. I don't have a job yet, but I'm considering something in psychology, influenced by my interest in child psychology. Currently single, I enjoy spending time with friends both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge mainly stems from self-teaching and online communities. I've learned a lot about Duel Masters through online forums and YouTube videos. My interest in witchcraft and child psychology is more recent and comes from reading extensively and watching documentaries.
